description: Calls per day for the last N days (UTC days, all keys combined, MCP handshakes excluded). For spend use everyinfra_billing. Needs the account read permission "requests:read" on this key: keys not limited to product lines have the three read permissions by default; for a key limited to product lines, the account owner turns it on in the console (API Keys → permissions). Free.
name: everyinfra_usage
title: Daily usage
